Map of the counties of Oldenburg and Delmenhorst published in 1761.
Designed by J.W.A. Hunrichs  and published by Homann Heirs (Homann Erben). Dedicated to King Frederick V of Denmark. Both counties were ruled by the king of Denmark. Delmenhorst was absorbed by Oldenburg in the 1770s.
